picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's Claude reportedly produced a verified proof of the Riemann Hypothesis working alongside a mathematician — if it holds up, this is a landmark demonstration of AI contributing to one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics.
picks.title: AI Takes on the Riemann Hypothesis: What Does It Mean for the Future of Mathematics?

picks.editorial_note: DOE leadership and a national lab director publicly outlined combining AI/superintelligence with HPC as a national science strategy, signaling how deeply AI is being woven into federal research priorities.
picks.title: Genesis Mission assembles Avengers to accelerate American science

picks.editorial_note: A £10M, nearly 700,000-participant trial is the largest-ever test of AI-assisted mammography, with the potential to reshape breast cancer screening protocols across the UK if successful.
picks.title: Cambridge co-leading world’s largest trial to use AI to help detect breast cancers earlier

picks.editorial_note: A $22.95M NSF-funded supercomputer significantly expands AI and research computing capacity for two universities, a major infrastructure investment with broad downstream research benefits.
picks.title: Stony Brook University Receives Hardware for NSF-Funded Supercomputer, Kitsune - SBU News

picks.editorial_note: A $25M philanthropic investment to integrate AI across higher education curricula is one of the largest single gifts in this batch aimed at reshaping how a university teaches AI literacy.
picks.title: Indiana University receives $25M from Lilly Endowment to drive AI innovation

picks.editorial_note: A three-way partnership between a university, city transportation department, and a national lab testing real-world adaptive AI traffic control shows tangible public-infrastructure impact from AI research.
picks.title: Vanderbilt, NDOT, Oak Ridge National Laboratory team up to ease traffic with AI

picks.editorial_note: An AI disaster-response tool built on university research has moved beyond the lab to national recognition and expanding real-world adoption by emergency responders, a rare case of academic AI deployed operationally.
picks.title: Texas A&M disaster-response AI gains national recognition, expanded use among emergency responders – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Being chosen to coordinate a national AI research flagship (and participate in four more) marks a major strategic win that will concentrate funding and talent around one university's AI research agenda.
picks.title: Aalto coordinates new AI research flagship and is involved in four others | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: A Nature Sustainability study quantifying AI data centers' outsized electricity consumption adds hard evidence to the policy debate over AI's energy footprint and grid strain.
picks.title: These U.S. data centers use four times the power used in LA

picks.editorial_note: A $1M grant plus Google Cloud credits to build an AI-for-Science framework shows industry capital flowing directly into academic AI infrastructure for scientific research.
picks.title: University of Warsaw
